versions.changelog: Preserve the scripts/ directory layout in the published package so the documented script paths resolve after install.

Consolidated release. Fixes Zoho CRM MCP response handling (normalizes the nested {data:{data,info}} shape returned by the COQL endpoint), adds automatic pagination for contacts/accounts, and adds --fields / --where for custom Zoho fields and filters. Drops OpenClaw-specific framing: the skill is agent-agnostic. Supersedes the zoho-crm-mcp-openclaw-skill listing.

- Removed all bundled helper scripts and documentation files: LICENSE, README.md, sample scripts, and skill-card.md.
- This version no longer includes ready-to-use Python scripts for CRM operations.
- Retains core documentation in SKILL.md; all usage and instructions now provided there.
- No changes to core MCP/Zoho CRM integration functionality.
Expose GitHub source link in the skill documentation
Move source to GitHub and remove shell-based mcporter calls
Updated v1.3.0 - all English, env var requirement
Initial release: CRM contact search, account listing, COQL queries, and mcporter usage patterns
